launches.title: Odo: Stop checking your own email
launches.tagline: Odo monitors your inbox, flags only the important emails, and drafts replies for you
launches.body:
**TLDR**

Odo monitors your inbox, flags only the important emails, and drafts replies for you. Get early access at [useodo.com](http://useodo.com).

<https://youtu.be/GoNZ7ZjTf2I>
\
**Problem**

Have you woken up in the middle of the night because you forgot to handle an important email?

You’re reading hundreds of emails a day just to figure out which five actually need a response. Then you’re manually writing replies you’ve written a dozen times before. Meanwhile, the one email that actually mattered got buried under Linkedin notifications “We’ve got a great role for you!”

**Solution**

Odo is an email assistant that flags what’s important and drafts replies in your own voice. You’ll never miss an important message again!

**Brief:** Odo scans your inbox overnight and gives you a daily brief: what needs your attention and replies for you to review. Odo drafts in your own voice instead of sounding like AI.

**Chat:** Need to follow-up with 40 prospects from a conference? Draft an investor update and bcc all 30 investors? Just ask Odo.

**Inbox:** Your email is pre-sorted into conversations, notifications, news, and cold outreach so important emails rise to the top.

**About us**

We met at Robinhood where Yooni spent 5 years across product and biz ops and Andrew was a staff engineer. Yooni ran sales for multiple startup ideas and kept losing sleep over emails falling through the cracks. Andrew ran his own email server for 10 years and has been itching to fix email.

launches.title: 💪 Odo: Win more government contracts
launches.tagline: We save 80% of time drafting proposals so you can win more government contracts at a fraction of the cost.
launches.body:
**TLDR: Odo helps businesses find relevant government contracts, draft proposals, and analyze wins and losses through public records sourcing.**

**🙏 Ask:** If you are a company selling to state or local government, we can help expedite your sales cycle. Book a demo [here,](https://www.odo.do/book-demo/) and we’ll draft **one proposal for free.**

If you know anyone who sells professional services or software to the government, we would appreciate an intro! Please reach out to us at [founders@odo.do](mailto:founders@odo.do). 

❗ **Problem**

State and local governments buy $1.5TN worth of products and services from businesses every year, ranging from consulting and constructions, to yes, cream cheese and bagels. However, the process of winning government contracts today is extremely manual and opaque. Businesses can’t easily find relevant contracts, spend 40-80 hours drafting proposals, and don’t get feedback on why they won or lost a contract.

![](https://media4.giphy.com/media/d9CX7F5Um8vzZIZOp4/giphy.gif?cid=6367ce563r70btn8vz9w1qmlmfzt1zke0dxxs2d5atm5vq8m&ep=v1_gifs_search&rid=giphy.gif&ct=g)

**🎉 Solution**

Odo is the first AI-powered platform to help businesses win state and local government contracts. Odo can find relevant contracts, draft proposals, and analyze wins and losses through public records sourcing. Our customers have saved up to **80% of their time** spent drafting proposals and **doubled their government sales pipeline.**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=81408&key=user_uploads/1293727/84ab8966-6296-4433-a1b2-79ab5d27955e)
